' ESCORT - for the ZX Spectrum Next, in NTC BASIC.
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
'
' A red convertible, an open road, and a fare who needs getting somewhere - fast. She waits by
' the road; pull up next to her, and she's in. Her stop is always straight ahead, but the road
' forks now and then (the signs say which way), there's traffic, oil, logs - and black cars
' that want her, and want you off the road. Your car has a few surprises of its own:
'   machine guns (forward), missiles (they find the black cars), an oil slick (behind you) and
'   a smoke screen (behind you: they lose you).
' Get her there, stop by the chequered flag, collect the fare. The clock is always running: each
' pick-up and each drop-off buys more time. Run out of time, or wreck the car, and it's over.
'
' Keys: O P (or Z C, 5 8, joystick): steer. Q (or S, 7, joystick up): accelerate.
'       A (or X, 6, joystick down): brake. Space (M, 0, fire): guns. N (fire 2): missile.
'       B: oil. V: smoke.
'
' The road and the sky are Layer 2, bent and striped line by line by the copper (Road.cls);
' everything by the road, on it and in it are sprites, drawn at 7 sizes (3 drawings x 1, 2, 4);
' the HUD is the tilemap; the engine and the rest are the AY.
Option Explicit
Option Turbo

Const NO = 22                            ' things by and on the road
Const HORN = 84                          ' the horizon on the flat
Const VMAX = 107                         ' 300 km/h (speeds in 64ths of a metre a frame)
Const CARD = 128                         ' your car is 8 metres ahead of the eye (16ths)
Const ROADW = 80, KERB = 92              ' the road's half width; to the kerbs' edge
Const SP_OBJ = 4, SP_CAR = 30, SP_PUFF = 32
' kinds
Const K_PALM = 1, K_BUSH = 2, K_PINE = 3, K_SIGNL = 4, K_SIGNR = 5, K_GORE = 6, K_CAR = 7, K_TRUCK = 8
Const K_OIL = 9, K_LOG = 10, K_DEST = 11, K_PUFF = 12, K_MISSILE = 13, K_GIRL = 14, K_ENEMY = 15
Const K_SHOT = 16, K_BOOM = 17, K_MYOIL = 18

Dim longText As String Max 80
' the things: kind, where (metres along the road + 64ths), across (1/128 of 6 m), speed, life,
' a timer, palette, how far from the eye this frame (16ths)
Dim okind(21) As Integer, oz(21) As Integer, ozf(21) As Integer, ox(21) As Integer, ov(21) As Integer
Dim ohp(21) As Integer, ot(21) As Integer, opal(21) As Integer, od(21) As Integer, ord(21) As Integer
Dim far(21) As Integer               ' how far, for sorting (gone: -30000, last)
' per kind: first pattern, the size the full drawing stands for, half its width, what hitting it does
' (0 nothing, 1 a crash, 2 a car, 3 oil, 4 a log, 5 a bush)
Dim kpat(18) As Integer, kfull(18) As Integer, khalf(18) As Integer, ksolid(18) As Integer
' planned things: where, kind, across (spawned when they come into view)
Dim pz(11) As Integer, pk(11) As Integer, px(11) As Integer
' you
Dim posM As Integer, posF As Integer, v As Integer, carx As Integer, camx As Integer, steer As Integer
Dim spinT As Integer, crashT As Integer, dmg As Integer, cool As Integer, smokeT As Integer
Dim nMis As Integer, nOil As Integer, nSmoke As Integer, misWas As Integer, oilWas As Integer, smkWas As Integer
' the road
Dim hor As Integer, curv As Integer, curT As Integer, hill As Integer, hillT As Integer, segEnd As Integer
Dim skyx As Integer, skyF As Integer
' the job
Dim mission As Integer, destZ As Integer, forkZ As Integer, forkSide As Integer, forkDone As Integer, forkWarn As Integer
Dim nextGirl As Integer, girlN As Integer, rideDmg As Integer, rideT As Integer, delivered As Integer
Dim nextScn As Integer, nextCar As Integer, nextHaz As Integer, enemyT As Integer
Dim money As Long, best As Long, timeLeft As Integer, over As Integer, why As Integer
Dim frames As Integer, msgT As Integer, hudT As Integer, demo As Integer
Dim i As Integer, k As Integer, n As Integer

Setup
Nx.Border 0
Tiles.Init
Spr.Init
GfxData.Load
Sfx.Init
Road.Init
Nx.Layers Nx.OrderSUL                    ' sprites over the HUD, the HUD over the road
Nx.Reg &H1C, 2                           ' the sprites cut to the paper under the HUD
Nx.Reg &H19, 16 : Nx.Reg &H19, 143 : Nx.Reg &H19, 48 : Nx.Reg &H19, 223
Nx.Reg &H15, Nx.RegGet(&H15) Or &H20
best = 500
Do
  Title
  Game
Loop

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- tables
Sub Setup()
  Kind K_PALM, GfxData.S_PALM, 170, 10, 1
  Kind K_BUSH, GfxData.S_BUSH, 70, 30, 5
  Kind K_PINE, GfxData.S_PINE, 140, 10, 1
  Kind K_SIGNL, GfxData.S_SIGNL, 100, 10, 1
  Kind K_SIGNR, GfxData.S_SIGNR, 100, 10, 1
  Kind K_GORE, GfxData.S_GORE, 100, 30, 1
  Kind K_CAR, GfxData.S_CAR, 48, 24, 2
  Kind K_TRUCK, GfxData.S_TRUCK, 64, 32, 2
  Kind K_OIL, GfxData.S_OIL, 64, 30, 3
  Kind K_LOG, GfxData.S_LOG, 64, 32, 4
  Kind K_DEST, GfxData.S_DEST, 210, 0, 0
  Kind K_PUFF, GfxData.S_PUFF, 64, 0, 0
  Kind K_MISSILE, GfxData.S_MISSILE, 24, 0, 0
  Kind K_GIRL, GfxData.S_GIRL, 70, 0, 0
  Kind K_ENEMY, GfxData.S_CAR, 48, 24, 2
  Kind K_SHOT, GfxData.S_SHOT, 32, 0, 0
  Kind K_BOOM, GfxData.S_BOOM, 80, 0, 0
  Kind K_MYOIL, GfxData.S_OIL, 64, 0, 0
End Sub

Sub Kind(ByVal kd As Integer, ByVal pat As Integer, ByVal full As Integer, ByVal half As Integer, ByVal solid As Integer)
  kpat(kd) = pat : kfull(kd) = full : khalf(kd) = half : ksolid(kd) = solid
End Sub

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- the screen
Sub Hud()
  Tiles.Fill 0
  Tiles.Rect 4, 4, 32, 2, GfxData.T_HUD
  ShowTop
  ShowJob
  ShowKit
End Sub

Sub ShowTop()
  Dim f As Integer
  longText = "TIME " & Right$(" " & Trim$(Str$((timeLeft + 49) \ 50)), 2) & "  $" & Right$("0000" & Trim$(Str$(money)), 5)
  longText = longText & " " & Right$("  " & Trim$(Str$(v * 45 \ 16)), 3) & "KMH"
  Tiles.Text 4, 4, longText
  Tiles.Text 27, 4, "DMG"
  For k = 0 To 4
    f = dmg * 40 \ 100 - k * 8
    If f < 0 Then f = 0
    If f > 8 Then f = 8
    Tiles.Put 31 + k, 4, GfxData.T_DMG + f
  Next
End Sub

Sub ShowJob()
  If mission = 0 Then
    longText = "PICK HER UP     "
    If (frames And 32) = 0 Then longText = "                "
  Else
    longText = "DROP OFF " & Right$("    " & Trim$(Str$(destZ - posM)), 5) & "M "
  End If
  Tiles.Text 4, 5, longText
End Sub

Sub ShowKit()
  Tiles.Text 22, 5, "MSL" & Trim$(Str$(nMis)) & " OIL" & Trim$(Str$(nOil)) & " SMK" & Trim$(Str$(nSmoke))
End Sub

' a message across the middle for t frames (0: until the next)
Sub Message(ByVal m As String, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal t As Integer)
  longText = m
  Tiles.Rect 4, y, 32, 1, 0
  Tiles.Text 4 + (32 - Len(longText)) \ 2, y, longText
  If t Then msgT = t
End Sub

Sub ClearMessages()
  Tiles.Rect 4, 7, 32, 22, 0
End Sub

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- the title
Sub Title()
  Dim y As Integer
  Spr.HideRange 0, 40 : Spr.Show
  NewRun
  demo = 1
  Hud
  Tiles.Rect 4, 4, 32, 2, GfxData.T_HUD
  Tiles.Text 4, 4, "BEST $" & Trim$(Str$(best))
  Message "E  S  C  O  R  T", 8, 0
  Message "PICK HER UP. GET HER THERE.", 10, 0
  Message "STEER O P  GAS Q  BRAKE A", 12, 0
  Message "SPACE GUNS  N MISSILE", 13, 0
  Message "B OIL  V SMOKE", 14, 0
  Message "(C) 2026 CYBORG UNICORN", 26, 0
  y = 0
  Do
    DemoDrive
    Drive
    Frame
    Road.Show
    Spr.Show
    Road.ShowObj
    Sfx.Update
    frames = frames + 1
    y = y + 1
    If y = 30 Then Message "PRESS SPACE", 23, 0
    If y = 60 Then Tiles.Rect 4, 23, 32, 1, 0 : y = 0
  Loop Until FireDown()
  Do
    Frame
  Loop While FireDown()
  demo = 0
  ClearMessages
  Sfx.Play 0, 200, -6, 15, 25, 0
End Sub

' the title's car drives itself: down the middle at a steady speed
Sub DemoDrive()
  steer = 0
  If carx < -8 Then steer = 1
  If carx > 8 Then steer = -1
  If v < 70 Then v = v + 1
End Sub

Function FireDown() As Integer
  FireDown = Keys.Down(Keys.KeySpace) Or Keys.Down(Keys.KeyM) Or Keys.Down(Keys.Key0) Or ((Keys.Joystick(0) And Keys.JoyFire1) <> 0)
End Function

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- a run
Sub NewRun()
  For n = 0 To NO - 1
    okind(n) = 0 : ord(n) = n : far(n) = -30000
  Next
  For n = 0 To 11
    pk(n) = 0
  Next
  posM = 100 : posF = 0 : v = 0 : carx = 0 : camx = 0 : spinT = 0 : crashT = 0 : dmg = 0 : smokeT = 0
  hor = HORN : curv = 0 : curT = 0 : hill = 0 : hillT = 0 : segEnd = 300 : skyx = 0 : skyF = 0
  mission = 0 : nextGirl = 400 : girlN = -1 : forkZ = 0 : delivered = 0
  nextScn = 100 : nextCar = 500 : nextHaz = 900 : enemyT = 300
  money = 0 : timeLeft = 3000 : over = 0
  nMis = 3 : nOil = 3 : nSmoke = 3
  ' the roadside to start with
  Do While nextScn < posM + 320
    AddScenery
  Loop
End Sub

Sub Game()
  Dim y As Integer
  NewRun
  Spr.HideRange 0, 40
  Hud
  Message "SHE'S WAITING UP THE ROAD", 10, 150
  misWas = 1 : oilWas = 1 : smkWas = 1
  Do
    Controls
    Drive
    If (frames And 7) = 0 Then ShowTop
    If (frames And 15) = 8 Then ShowJob
    If msgT > 0 Then
      msgT = msgT - 1
      If msgT = 0 Then ClearMessages
    End If
    Frame
    Road.Show
    Spr.Show
    Road.ShowObj
    Sfx.Update
    frames = frames + 1
    If timeLeft > 4950 Then timeLeft = 4950
    If timeLeft > 0 Then timeLeft = timeLeft - 1
    If timeLeft = 0 Then over = 1 : why = 0
    If dmg >= 100 Then over = 1 : why = 1
  Loop Until over
  ' the end: the car rolls to a stop
  ShowTop
  If why = 0 Then Message "OUT OF TIME", 12, 0 Else Message "WRECKED", 12, 0
  Message "YOU MADE $" & Trim$(Str$(money)), 14, 0
  If money > best Then best = money : Message "THE BEST YET", 16, 0
  For y = 1 To 250
    steer = 0
    If v > 0 Then v = v - 1
    Drive
    Frame
    Road.Show
    Spr.Show
    Road.ShowObj
    Sfx.Update
    frames = frames + 1
    If y > 60 And FireDown() Then Exit For
  Next
  Do
    Frame
  Loop While FireDown()
  ClearMessages
End Sub

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- you
Sub Controls()
  Dim j0 As Integer, mx As Integer, my As Integer, b As Integer
  j0 = Keys.Joystick(0)
  mx = 0 : my = 0
  If Keys.Down(Keys.KeyO) Or Keys.Down(Keys.KeyZ) Or Keys.Down(Keys.Key5) Or (j0 And Keys.JoyLeft) Then mx = -1
  If Keys.Down(Keys.KeyP) Or Keys.Down(Keys.KeyC) Or Keys.Down(Keys.Key8) Or (j0 And Keys.JoyRight) Then mx = 1
  If Keys.Down(Keys.KeyQ) Or Keys.Down(Keys.KeyS) Or Keys.Down(Keys.Key7) Or (j0 And Keys.JoyUp) Then my = -1
  If Keys.Down(Keys.KeyA) Or Keys.Down(Keys.KeyX) Or Keys.Down(Keys.Key6) Or (j0 And Keys.JoyDown) Then my = 1
  steer = mx
  If crashT > 0 Then steer = 0 : my = 0
  ' the pedals
  If my < 0 Then
    If v < VMAX And (frames And 1) = 0 Then v = v + 1
    If v < 30 Then v = v + 1               ' off the line quicker
  ElseIf my > 0 Then
    v = v - 3
  ElseIf (frames And 7) = 0 Then
    v = v - 1
  End If
  If v < 0 Then v = 0
  ' the guns: two tracers up the road
  If cool > 0 Then cool = cool - 1
  If FireDown() And cool = 0 And crashT = 0 Then
    n = NewObj(K_SHOT, posM + 9, carx - 18)
    If n >= 0 Then ov(n) = v + 180 : ot(n) = 22
    n = NewObj(K_SHOT, posM + 9, carx + 18)
    If n >= 0 Then ov(n) = v + 180 : ot(n) = 22
    cool = 7
    Sfx.Play 1, 20, 3, 10, 3, 1
  End If
  ' a missile
  b = Keys.Down(Keys.KeyN) Or ((j0 And Keys.JoyFire2) <> 0)
  If b And misWas = 0 And crashT = 0 Then
    If nMis > 0 Then
      n = NewObj(K_MISSILE, posM + 9, carx)
      If n >= 0 Then ov(n) = v + 120 : ot(n) = 100 : nMis = nMis - 1 : ShowKit : Sfx.Play 2, 60, 4, 13, 30, 1
    Else
      Sfx.Play 1, 400, 0, 8, 6, 0
    End If
  End If
  misWas = b
  ' an oil slick, left behind you
  b = Keys.Down(Keys.KeyB)
  If b And oilWas = 0 Then
    If nOil > 0 Then
      n = NewObj(K_MYOIL, posM + 5, carx)
      If n >= 0 Then nOil = nOil - 1 : ShowKit : Sfx.Play 2, 200, 10, 12, 15, 1
    Else
      Sfx.Play 1, 400, 0, 8, 6, 0
    End If
  End If
  oilWas = b
  ' the smoke screen
  b = Keys.Down(Keys.KeyV)
  If b And smkWas = 0 Then
    If nSmoke > 0 And smokeT = 0 Then
      smokeT = 150 : nSmoke = nSmoke - 1 : ShowKit : Sfx.Play 2, 31, 0, 12, 40, 1
    Else
      Sfx.Play 1, 400, 0, 8, 6, 0
    End If
  End If
  smkWas = b
End Sub

' a frame of driving: the car, the road, the things on it, the job
Sub Drive()
  Dim off As Integer, zpos As Integer
  ' along the road
  posF = posF + v
  Do While posF >= 64
    posF = posF - 64 : posM = posM + 1
    Metre
  Loop
  ' across: steering, the bends pushing you out, oil spinning you
  If spinT > 0 Then
    spinT = spinT - 1
    steer = 1 - 2 * ((spinT \ 6) And 1)
  End If
  If crashT > 0 Then
    crashT = crashT - 1
    If carx > ROADW - 20 Then carx = carx - 4
    If carx < 20 - ROADW Then carx = carx + 4
  End If
  carx = carx + steer * (2 + v \ 14)
  carx = carx - curv * v \ 3000
  If carx > 220 Then carx = 220
  If carx < -220 Then carx = -220
  off = (carx > KERB Or carx < -KERB)
  If off And v > 40 Then v = v - 2         ' on the grass
  ' the eye follows you a third of the way across
  camx = carx \ 3
  ' the sky turns with the bends
  skyF = skyF + curv * v \ 64
  skyx = (skyx + skyF \ 96) And 255
  skyF = skyF Mod 96
  zpos = ((posM And 1023) * 16 + posF \ 4) And 16383
  Road.Build hor, curv, camx, zpos, skyx
  ' the engine
  If (frames And 3) = 0 Then Sfx.Play 0, 380 - v * 3, 0, 7 + v \ 30, 6, 0
  Things
  DrawCar off
  If demo = 0 Then Job
  If smokeT > 0 Then smokeT = smokeT - 1
End Sub

' each metre: the road changes (bends, hills), things are put ahead
Sub Metre()
  ' bends and hills, a little each metre
  If curv < curT Then curv = curv + 1
  If curv > curT Then curv = curv - 1
  If (posM And 3) = 0 Then
    If hill < hillT Then hill = hill + 1
    If hill > hillT Then hill = hill - 1
    hor = HORN - hill
  End If
  If posM >= segEnd Then NewSegment
  If posM + 320 >= nextScn Then AddScenery
  If posM + 450 >= nextCar Then Traffic
  If posM + 450 >= nextHaz Then Hazard
  For i = 0 To 11
    If pk(i) Then
      If posM + 450 >= pz(i) Then
        n = NewObj(pk(i), pz(i), px(i))
        pk(i) = 0
      End If
    End If
  Next
  ' the black cars come when she's with you
  If mission = 1 And demo = 0 Then
    If enemyT > 0 Then enemyT = enemyT - 1
    If enemyT = 0 Then NewEnemy
  End If
End Sub

Sub NewSegment()
  Dim r As Integer
  segEnd = posM + 150 + Rnd(300)
  r = Rnd(10)
  If r < 3 Then
    curT = 0
  ElseIf r < 6 Then
    curT = 40 + Rnd(30)
  Else
    curT = 70 + Rnd(50)
  End If
  If Rnd(2) Then curT = -curT
  r = Rnd(6)
  hillT = 0
  If r = 1 Then hillT = 10
  If r = 2 Then hillT = -8
  If r = 3 Then hillT = 6
End Sub

Sub AddScenery()
  Dim r As Integer, kd As Integer, side As Integer
  r = Rnd(10)
  kd = K_PALM
  If r > 5 Then kd = K_BUSH
  If r = 9 Then kd = K_PINE
  side = 1 - 2 * Rnd(2)
  n = NewObj(kd, nextScn, side * (115 + Rnd(130)))
  If Rnd(2) = 0 Then n = NewObj(K_PALM, nextScn + 5, -side * (120 + Rnd(100)))
  nextScn = nextScn + 18 + Rnd(16)
End Sub

Sub Traffic()
  Dim kd As Integer
  kd = K_CAR
  If Rnd(4) = 0 Then kd = K_TRUCK
  n = NewObj(kd, nextCar, 40 - 80 * Rnd(2))
  If n >= 0 Then
    ov(n) = 35 + Rnd(30)
    If kd = K_CAR Then opal(n) = 1 + Rnd(3)
  End If
  nextCar = nextCar + 250 + Rnd(250)
End Sub

Sub Hazard()
  Dim kd As Integer
  kd = K_OIL
  If Rnd(3) = 0 Then kd = K_LOG
  n = NewObj(kd, nextHaz, (Rnd(3) - 1) * 44)
  nextHaz = nextHaz + 450 + Rnd(400) - delivered * 30
  If nextHaz < posM + 700 Then nextHaz = posM + 700
End Sub

Sub NewEnemy()
  Dim c As Integer, m As Integer
  c = 0
  For m = 0 To NO - 1
    If okind(m) = K_ENEMY Then c = c + 1
  Next
  enemyT = 200 + Rnd(300) - delivered * 15
  If enemyT < 120 Then enemyT = 120
  If c > delivered \ 2 Or c >= 3 Then Exit Sub
  n = NewObj(K_ENEMY, posM - 30, (Rnd(3) - 1) * 44)
  If n >= 0 Then
    ov(n) = v + 20 : ohp(n) = 4 : opal(n) = 4 : ot(n) = 0
    Message "THEY'RE BEHIND YOU!", 10, 80
    Sfx.Play 2, 300, -8, 13, 40, 0
  End If
End Sub

' a free thing of a kind, at z (metres) and x; -1 if there's no room
Function NewObj(ByVal kd As Integer, ByVal z As Integer, ByVal x As Integer) As Integer
  Dim m As Integer
  NewObj = -1
  For m = 0 To NO - 1
    If okind(m) = 0 Then
      okind(m) = kd : oz(m) = z : ozf(m) = 0 : ox(m) = x : ov(m) = 0 : ohp(m) = 1 : ot(m) = 0 : opal(m) = 0
      od(m) = (z - posM) * 16
      NewObj = m
      Exit Function
    End If
  Next
End Function

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- the things
Sub Things()
  Dim q As Integer, d As Integer, kd As Integer, rel As Integer, dx As Integer, pf As Integer
  pf = posF \ 4
  For q = 0 To NO - 1
    kd = okind(q)
    If kd Then
      If ov(q) Then
        ozf(q) = ozf(q) + ov(q)
        Do While ozf(q) >= 64
          ozf(q) = ozf(q) - 64 : oz(q) = oz(q) + 1
        Loop
      End If
      If ozf(q) Then d = (oz(q) - posM) * 16 + ozf(q) \ 4 - pf Else d = (oz(q) - posM) * 16 - pf
      od(q) = d
      If kd = K_ENEMY Then
        Enemy q, d
      ElseIf kd = K_SHOT Then
        ot(q) = ot(q) - 1
        If ot(q) <= 0 Then okind(q) = 0 Else ShotHits q
      ElseIf kd = K_MISSILE Then
        ot(q) = ot(q) - 1
        If ot(q) <= 0 Then okind(q) = 0 Else Missile q
      ElseIf kd = K_BOOM Then
        ot(q) = ot(q) + 1
        If ot(q) >= 16 Then okind(q) = 0
      End If
      kd = okind(q)
      far(q) = d
      ' gone behind
      If kd And kd <> K_ENEMY And d < -64 Then okind(q) = 0 : kd = 0
      If kd = 0 Then far(q) = -30000
      ' hitting it
      If kd Then
        rel = d - CARD
        If rel > -24 And rel < 24 And crashT = 0 And ksolid(kd) > 0 Then
          dx = Abs(ox(q) - carx)
          If dx < khalf(kd) + 22 Then Hit q, kd, dx
        End If
      End If
    End If
  Next
End Sub

' you hit thing q
Sub Hit(ByVal o As Integer, ByVal kd As Integer, ByVal dx As Integer)
  Dim s As Integer
  s = ksolid(kd)
  If s = 1 Then
    ' a tree, a sign, the barrier: a crash
    Boom oz(o), ox(o)
    v = 0 : crashT = 50 : dmg = dmg + 20 : rideDmg = 1
    If carx > ox(o) Then carx = carx + 20 Else carx = carx - 20
    Message "CRASH!", 10, 50
    Sfx.Play 2, 31, 0, 15, 50, 1
    Sfx.Play 1, 600, 10, 14, 30, 0
  ElseIf s = 2 Then
    ' a car: from behind, it slows you; from the side, it pushes you
    If v > ov(o) - 4 Then
      v = ov(o) - 10
      If v < 0 Then v = 0
      ov(o) = ov(o) + 6
      dmg = dmg + 5 : rideDmg = 1
      If carx > ox(o) Then carx = carx + 14 Else carx = carx - 14
      If okind(o) = K_ENEMY Then ohp(o) = ohp(o) - 1
      Sfx.Play 2, 31, 0, 13, 12, 1
    End If
  ElseIf s = 3 Then
    If spinT = 0 Then spinT = 48 : v = v * 3 \ 4 : Message "OIL!", 10, 40 : Sfx.Play 1, 50, 6, 13, 30, 1
  ElseIf s = 4 Then
    v = v \ 3 : dmg = dmg + 12 : rideDmg = 1
    Boom oz(o), ox(o)
    okind(o) = 0
    Message "BANG!", 10, 40
    Sfx.Play 2, 31, 0, 15, 30, 1
  ElseIf s = 5 Then
    If v > 30 Then v = v - 12
    dmg = dmg + 1
    ozf(o) = 0 : oz(o) = posM + 5        ' (once)
  End If
End Sub

' a black car: it catches you up, comes alongside and rams you - unless the smoke hides you, or it
' runs over your oil
Sub Enemy(ByVal o As Integer, ByVal d As Integer)
  Dim rel As Integer, m As Integer, dx As Integer
  rel = d - CARD
  If smokeT > 0 And rel < 0 Then
    ov(o) = v - 30
    If ov(o) < 0 Then ov(o) = 0
    ox(o) = ox(o) + 3 - Rnd(7)
  ElseIf rel < -40 Then
    ov(o) = v + 22
  ElseIf rel > 80 Then
    ov(o) = v - 14
  Else
    ov(o) = v + 1 - (rel \ 16)
    ' at your side: in for the ram
    dx = carx - ox(o)
    If dx > 4 Then ox(o) = ox(o) + 3
    If dx < -4 Then ox(o) = ox(o) - 3
    If ot(o) > 0 Then ot(o) = ot(o) - 1
    If Abs(dx) < 52 And Abs(rel) < 40 And ot(o) = 0 And crashT = 0 Then
      If dx > 0 Then carx = carx + 34 : ox(o) = ox(o) - 10 Else carx = carx - 34 : ox(o) = ox(o) + 10
      dmg = dmg + 4 : rideDmg = 1 : ot(o) = 25
      Sfx.Play 2, 31, 0, 14, 15, 1
    End If
  End If
  If ov(o) < 0 Then ov(o) = 0
  ' your oil
  For m = 0 To NO - 1
    If okind(m) = K_MYOIL Then
      If Abs(oz(m) - oz(o)) < 3 And Abs(ox(m) - ox(o)) < 44 Then
        okind(m) = 0
        KillEnemy o, "SPUN OUT!"
        Exit Sub
      End If
    End If
  Next
  If ohp(o) <= 0 Then KillEnemy o, "GOT ONE!" : Exit Sub
  ' too far back: it gives up
  If rel < -2400 Or rel > 12000 Then okind(o) = 0
End Sub

Sub KillEnemy(ByVal o As Integer, ByVal m As String)
  Boom oz(o), ox(o)
  okind(o) = 0
  money = money + 50
  Message m & " +$50", 10, 50
  Sfx.Play 2, 31, 0, 15, 50, 1
End Sub

' a tracer: does it hit a car?
Sub ShotHits(ByVal o As Integer)
  Dim m As Integer, kd As Integer
  For m = 0 To NO - 1
    kd = okind(m)
    If kd = K_ENEMY Or kd = K_CAR Or kd = K_TRUCK Then
      If Abs(od(m) - od(o)) < 48 And Abs(ox(m) - ox(o)) < khalf(kd) + 6 Then
        okind(o) = 0
        If kd = K_ENEMY Then
          ohp(m) = ohp(m) - 1
          opal(m) = 5
          Sfx.Play 1, 30, 2, 12, 4, 1
        End If
        Exit Sub
      End If
    End If
  Next
End Sub

' a missile: it steers for the nearest black car ahead
Sub Missile(ByVal o As Integer)
  Dim m As Integer, bm As Integer, bd As Integer
  bm = -1 : bd = 30000
  For m = 0 To NO - 1
    If okind(m) = K_ENEMY Then
      If od(m) > od(o) - 32 And od(m) - od(o) < bd Then bd = od(m) - od(o) : bm = m
    End If
  Next
  If bm >= 0 Then
    If ox(bm) > ox(o) + 4 Then ox(o) = ox(o) + 6
    If ox(bm) < ox(o) - 4 Then ox(o) = ox(o) - 6
    If bd < 48 And Abs(ox(bm) - ox(o)) < 40 Then
      okind(o) = 0
      KillEnemy bm, "BULLSEYE!"
    End If
  End If
End Sub

Sub Boom(ByVal z As Integer, ByVal x As Integer)
  Dim m As Integer
  m = NewObj(K_BOOM, z, x)
  If m >= 0 Then ot(m) = 0
End Sub

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- the job
Sub Job()
  Dim d As Integer, rel As Integer, fare As Integer
  If mission = 0 Then
    ' her, by the road
    If girlN < 0 And posM + 450 >= nextGirl Then
      girlN = NewObj(K_GIRL, nextGirl, 130)
    End If
    If girlN >= 0 Then
      If okind(girlN) <> K_GIRL Then
        girlN = -1
      Else
        rel = od(girlN) - CARD
        If rel < 320 And rel > -40 And v < 12 And carx > 30 Then
          ' she's in
          okind(girlN) = 0 : girlN = -1
          mission = 1 : rideDmg = 0 : rideT = 0
          destZ = posM + 1800 + Rnd(1500) + delivered * 150
          timeLeft = timeLeft + 750
          enemyT = 250
          PlanFork
          Message "SHE'S IN! STRAIGHT AHEAD, " & Trim$(Str$(destZ - posM)) & "M", 10, 120
          ShowJob
          Sfx.Play 0, 80, -2, 14, 30, 0
        ElseIf rel < -60 Then
          okind(girlN) = 0 : girlN = -1
          nextGirl = posM + 500
          Message "YOU DROVE RIGHT PAST HER!", 10, 90
        End If
      End If
    End If
  Else
    rideT = rideT + 1
    ' the fork: a warning, then which side were you?
    If forkZ > 0 And forkWarn = 0 And posM >= forkZ - 420 Then
      forkWarn = 1
      If forkSide = 0 Then Message "THE ROAD SPLITS: KEEP LEFT", 10, 150 Else Message "THE ROAD SPLITS: KEEP RIGHT", 10, 150
    End If
    If forkZ > 0 And forkDone = 0 And posM > forkZ + 130 Then
      forkDone = 1
      If (forkSide = 0 And carx > 0) Or (forkSide = 1 And carx < 0) Then
        destZ = destZ + 1000
        Message "WRONG WAY! THE LONG WAY ROUND", 10, 120
        Sfx.Play 1, 400, 4, 12, 30, 0
      Else
        Message "THAT'S THE WAY", 10, 60
      End If
    End If
    ' the flag
    If destZ - posM < 450 And girlN < 0 Then girlN = NewObj(K_DEST, destZ, 112)
    If girlN >= 0 Then
      If okind(girlN) = K_DEST Then
        rel = od(girlN) - CARD
        If rel < 320 And rel > -60 And v < 12 Then
          ' there: the fare
          fare = 100 + (3000 - rideT) \ 25
          If fare < 50 Then fare = 50
          If rideDmg = 0 Then fare = fare + 50 : Message "NOT A SCRATCH: TIP $50", 12, 120
          money = money + fare
          timeLeft = timeLeft + 1250
          delivered = delivered + 1
          nMis = 3 : nOil = 3 : nSmoke = 3 : ShowKit
          dmg = dmg - 15
          If dmg < 0 Then dmg = 0
          okind(girlN) = 0 : girlN = -1 : mission = 0
          nextGirl = posM + 450
          Message "THANKS, DRIVER! +$" & Trim$(Str$(fare)), 10, 120
          Sfx.Play 0, 100, -3, 15, 50, 0
          ShowJob
        ElseIf rel < -80 Then
          okind(girlN) = 0 : girlN = -1
          money = money - 20
          If money < 0 Then money = 0
          mission = 0 : nextGirl = posM + 450
          Message "TOO FAR! SHE WALKS. -$20", 10, 120
          ShowJob
        End If
      Else
        girlN = -1
      End If
    End If
  End If
End Sub

' a fork somewhere on the way (if it's far enough): signs, then the barrier down the middle
Sub PlanFork()
  Dim kd As Integer, m As Integer
  forkZ = 0 : forkDone = 0 : forkWarn = 0
  If destZ - posM < 1500 Then Exit Sub
  forkZ = posM + 700 + Rnd(500)
  forkSide = Rnd(2)
  If forkSide = 0 Then kd = K_SIGNL Else kd = K_SIGNR
  Plan 0, forkZ - 260, kd, 125
  Plan 1, forkZ - 260, kd, -125
  Plan 2, forkZ - 130, kd, 125
  Plan 3, forkZ - 130, kd, -125
  For m = 0 To 7
    Plan 4 + m, forkZ + m * 18, K_GORE, 0
  Next
End Sub

Sub Plan(ByVal i As Integer, ByVal z As Integer, ByVal kd As Integer, ByVal x As Integer)
  pz(i) = z : pk(i) = kd : px(i) = x
End Sub

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- drawing
' the things, far ones first (the near ones over them: one pass of sorting a frame keeps them so),
' then your car
Sub DrawCar(ByVal off As Integer)
  Dim x As Integer, y As Integer, pat As Integer, j As Integer, t As Integer, s As Integer
  ' one pass of sorting
  For j = 0 To NO - 2
    If far(ord(j + 1)) > far(ord(j)) Then t = ord(j) : ord(j) = ord(j + 1) : ord(j + 1) = t
  Next
  For j = 0 To NO - 1
    DrawObj ord(j), j
  Next
  ' your car: at the bottom, 8 metres ahead of the eye
  x = 128 + Road.Shift(111) + (carx \ 2) * 111 \ 64
  y = 190
  If off And (frames And 2) Then y = 189
  If crashT > 0 And (frames And 4) Then
    Spr.HideRange SP_CAR, 2
  Else
    pat = GfxData.S_PCAR
    If steer < 0 Then pat = pat + 2
    If steer > 0 Then pat = pat + 4
    If mission = 1 Then pat = pat + 6
    Spr.Put SP_CAR, x, y, pat, Spr.Scale2
    Spr.Put SP_CAR + 1, x + 32, y, pat + 1, Spr.Scale2
  End If
  ' the smoke screen: puffs behind you
  For j = 0 To 3
    If smokeT > 0 And smokeT > j * 30 Then
      s = (frames * 3 + j * 40) And 127
      Spr.Put SP_PUFF + j, x - 24 + j * 30 + (s And 15), 160 + (s \ 8), GfxData.S_PUFF + 2, Spr.Scale2
    Else
      Spr.Hide SP_PUFF + j
    End If
  Next
End Sub

' thing o as roadside sprite j (Road works out where and how big)
Sub DrawObj(ByVal o As Integer, ByVal j As Integer)
  Dim kd As Integer, pat As Integer, fl As Integer
  kd = okind(o)
  If kd = 0 Or kd = K_MYOIL Then
    Road.Obj j, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0
    Exit Sub
  End If
  pat = kpat(kd)
  fl = Spr.Pal * opal(o)
  If kd = K_GIRL And (frames And 16) <> 0 Then pat = pat + 3
  If kd = K_BOOM Then pat = pat + ot(o) \ 4 : fl = fl Or 1
  If kd = K_SHOT Then fl = fl Or 1
  If kd = K_ENEMY And opal(o) = 5 Then opal(o) = 4      ' hit: one white frame
  Road.Obj j, od(o), ox(o), pat, fl, kfull(kd)
End Sub

files.name: Nx.cls
files.text:
' Nx - the ZX Spectrum Next's own hardware, straight on the ports: NextRegs (#243B select,
' #253B value), the layer order, the border, palettes, the CPU speed.
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
' No Z80N opcodes are used (plain out (c)), so any Z80 assembler builds it.
Option Explicit

' layer orders (NextReg #15 bits 4-2): first = on top. S sprites, L Layer 2, U ULA + tilemap
Public Const OrderSLU = 0
Public Const OrderLSU = 1
Public Const OrderSUL = 2
Public Const OrderLUS = 3
Public Const OrderUSL = 4
Public Const OrderULS = 5
' palettes for PalEntry / PalTable (NextReg #43 bits 6-4, the first of each pair)
Public Const PalULA = 0
Public Const PalLayer2 = 1
Public Const PalSprites = 2
Public Const PalTiles = 3

' Reg r, v: NextReg r = v
Public Sub Reg(ByVal r As Integer, ByVal v As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)
            ld bc, #243B
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), e
#endasm
End Sub

' RegGet(r): NextReg r read back
Public Function RegGet(ByVal r As Integer) As Integer
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld bc, #243B
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in e, (c)
            pop hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), 0
#endasm
End Function

' Layers order: which layer is on top (OrderSLU ...), sprites on and over the border kept
Public Sub Layers(ByVal order As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 7
            add a, a
            add a, a
            ld e, a
            ld bc, #243B
            ld a, #15
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in a, (c)
            and %11100011
            or e
            out (c), a
#endasm
End Sub

' Border c: the border colour (0-7, port #FE)
Public Sub Border(ByVal c As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 7
            out (#FE), a
#endasm
End Sub

' PalEntry which, index, colour: one colour (RRRGGGBB) of a palette (PalULA ... PalTiles, the
' first palette of each)
Public Sub PalEntry(ByVal which As Integer, ByVal index As Integer, ByVal colour As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 3
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            ld d, a                 ; palette select, bits 6-4
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)              ; index
            pop hl
            ld l, (hl)              ; colour
            ld bc, #243B
            ld a, #43
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), d
            dec b
            ld a, #40
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), e
            dec b
            ld a, #41
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), l
            dec b
            ld a, #43
            out (c), a
            inc b
            xor a
            out (c), a
#endasm
End Sub

' PalTable which, first, count, address: count colours (1 byte each, RRRGGGBB) from memory
Public Sub PalTable(ByVal which As Integer, ByVal first As Integer, ByVal count As Integer, ByVal address As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 3
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            ld d, a
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)
            ld bc, #243B
            ld a, #43
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), d
            dec b
            ld a, #40
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), e
            dec b
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)              ; count (1-256: 0 = 256)
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld a, #41
            out (c), a
            inc b
pt_lp:
            ld a, (hl)
            out (c), a
            inc hl
            dec e
            jr nz, pt_lp
            dec b
            ld a, #43
            out (c), a
            inc b
            xor a
            out (c), a
#endasm
End Sub

' Raster(): the line the display is on now (0-311; 0-191 the picture)
Public Function Raster() As Integer
#asm
            ld bc, #243B
rs_again:
            ld a, #1E
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in d, (c)
            dec b
            ld a, #1F
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in e, (c)
            dec b
            ld a, #1E
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in a, (c)
            dec b
            cp d
            jr nz, rs_again
            and 1
            ld d, a
            pop hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), d
#endasm
End Function

' Seed n: start Rnd's sequence from n (as Randomize n - kept here because Randomize with a
' variable doesn't link on its own in this NTC build: kw_seedv jumps into kw_seedl's section)
Public Sub Seed(ByVal n As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a
            or h
            jr nz, sd_ok
            inc l
sd_ok:
            ld (ntc_rnd_seed), hl
#endasm
End Sub

files.name: Spr.cls
files.text:
' Spr - the Next's 128 hardware sprites, straight on the ports (#303B slot, #57 attributes).
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
' 4 bit patterns (GfxData.Load puts them in the sprite RAM), 16 x 16 pixels, scaled 1x - 8x.
' Put / Hide write a table in RAM; Show sends the table to the hardware in one go (do it just
' after Frame, so nothing moves half way down the screen).
' Coordinates are the tilemap's: 0, 0 is the top left of the whole 320 x 256 picture (the
' border included); the 256 x 192 paper is 32 - 287 across, 32 - 223 down. A sprite at x -16 .. or
' y -16 .. wraps (512): keep it hidden instead.
Option Explicit

' flags for Put: add them
Public Const MirrorX = 8
Public Const MirrorY = 4
Public Const Rotate = 2
Public Const Scale2X = &H800
Public Const Scale2Y = &H200
Public Const Scale2 = &HA00
Public Const Scale4X = &H1000
Public Const Scale4Y = &H400
Public Const Scale4 = &H1400
' a palette offset: Pal * n (n 0 - 15: spr_pal.png's row n)
Public Const Pal = 16

Private tab(639) As Byte          ' 128 x 5 attribute bytes
Private used As Integer           ' the highest slot Put + 1 (Show sends that many)

' Init: every sprite hidden, sprites on (over the border too), transparent colour 15
Public Sub Init()
  Dim i As Integer
  For i = 0 To 639
    tab(i) = 0
  Next
  For i = 3 To 639 Step 5
    tab(i) = &H40                ' hidden, but still 5 bytes (the upload stays in step)
  Next
  used = 128
  Show
  used = 0
  Nx.Reg &H4B, &HF               ' 4 bit sprites: colour 15 is transparent
  Nx.Reg &H15, (Nx.RegGet(&H15) And &H1C) Or 3   ' sprites on, over the border; the order kept
End Sub

' Put n, x, y, pattern, flags: sprite n (0-127) at x, y showing pattern (0-127), with flags
' (MirrorX + Scale2 + Pal * 2 ...)
Public Sub Put(ByVal n As Integer, ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal pattern As Integer, ByVal flags As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 127
            ld c, a
            inc a
            ld hl, {used}
            cp (hl)
            jr c, sp_low
            ld (hl), a
sp_low:
            ld l, c                 ; DE = tab + n * 5
            ld h, 0
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld de, {tab}
            add hl, de
            ex de, hl
            pop hl                  ; x
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (de), a              ; attribute 0: x bits 0-7
            inc hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 1
            ld c, a                 ; x bit 8
            inc de
            pop hl                  ; y
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (de), a              ; attribute 1: y bits 0-7
            inc hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 1
            ld b, a                 ; y bit 8
            inc de
            pop hl                  ; pattern
            ld a, (hl)
            ex af, af'
            pop hl                  ; flags
            ld a, (hl)
            and #FE
            or c
            ld (de), a              ; attribute 2: palette offset, mirrors, rotate, x bit 8
            inc de
            inc hl
            ld c, (hl)              ; scale bits
            ex af, af'
            ld l, a
            srl a
            or #C0
            ld (de), a              ; attribute 3: visible, 5 bytes, pattern bits 6-1
            inc de
            ld a, l
            and 1
            rrca
            rrca
            or #80
            or b
            ld b, a
            ld a, c
            and #1E
            or b
            ld (de), a              ; attribute 4: 4 bit, pattern bit 0, scale, y bit 8
#endasm
End Sub

' Hide n: sprite n not shown
Public Sub Hide(ByVal n As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 127
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld de, {tab} + 3
            add hl, de
            ld (hl), #40            ; not visible, 5 bytes kept (else the upload slips a byte)
#endasm
End Sub

' HideRange first, count: those sprites not shown
Public Sub HideRange(ByVal first As Integer, ByVal count As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 127
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld de, {tab} + 3
            add hl, de
            ex de, hl
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            or a
            jr z, hr_done
            ld b, a
            ex de, hl
            ld de, 5
hr_lp:
            ld (hl), #40
            add hl, de
            djnz hr_lp
hr_done:
#endasm
End Sub

' Show: the table to the hardware (the slots up to the highest one Put)
Public Sub Show()
#asm
            ld a, ({used})
            or a
            jr z, sh_done
            ld bc, #303B
            xor a
            out (c), a
            ld a, ({used})
            ld e, a                 ; E sprites, 5 bytes each
            ld hl, {tab}
            ld c, #57
sh_lp:
            ld b, 5
            otir
            dec e
            jr nz, sh_lp
sh_done:
#endasm
End Sub

' Visible(n): True when sprite n is shown
Public Function Visible(ByVal n As Integer) As Integer
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 127
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld de, {tab} + 3
            add hl, de
            ld a, (hl)
            ld de, 0
            and #80
            jr z, vi_no
            dec de
vi_no:
            pop hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), d
#endasm
End Function

files.name: Tiles.cls
files.text:
' Tiles - the Next's tilemap as a 4 bit picture: 40 x 32 cells of 8 x 8 pixels over the whole
' 320 x 256 display (the border included), 16 colours (tile_pal.png), colour 15 transparent.
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
' The map stays where the platform put it (bank 5 + #2000, seen at #E000: one byte a cell, the
' tile number), so Print and Locate still work on it: the font is tiles 32-126 (a character's code
' is its tile). The tile definitions go to bank 5 + #0000 (#C000-#DFFF, 32 bytes a tile): the
' ULA screen's place, so the ULA is turned off. Don't use Mode or Cls after Init (Mode puts the
' platform's own text tiles back; Cls is all right but fills with tile 32).
' Print near the right edge or the last row wraps and scrolls: end prints with ; and keep them
' off row 32 and column 40.
Option Explicit

Public Const Cols = 40
Public Const Rows = 32
Private Const MAPA = &HE000

' Init: the tilemap on, 40 x 32, 4 bit tiles from #C000, no attribute bytes, over the ULA;
' the ULA off; no scroll; the whole picture
Public Sub Init()
  Nx.Reg &H68, Nx.RegGet(&H68) Or &H80     ' the ULA off (its screen's RAM holds the tiles)
  Nx.Reg &H6E, &H20                         ' the map: bank 5 + #2000
  Nx.Reg &H6F, &H0                          ' the tile definitions: bank 5 + #0000
  Nx.Reg &H6C, 0                            ' every cell: palette offset 0, no mirror
  Nx.Reg &H4C, &HF                          ' colour 15 transparent
  Nx.Reg &H2F, 0 : Nx.Reg &H30, 0 : Nx.Reg &H31, 0
  Nx.Reg &H1C, 8                            ' the clip window: all of it
  Nx.Reg &H1B, 0 : Nx.Reg &H1B, 159 : Nx.Reg &H1B, 0 : Nx.Reg &H1B, 255
  Nx.Reg &H6B, &HA1                         ' on, 40 x 32, no attributes, 4 bit, over the ULA
End Sub

' Put x, y, t: cell x (0-39), y (0-31) shows tile t
Public Sub Put(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal t As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld c, (hl)              ; x
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)              ; y
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de              ; y * 40
            ld b, #E0
            add hl, bc
            ex de, hl
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (de), a
#endasm
End Sub

' Get(x, y): the tile in cell x, y
Public Function Get(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer) As Integer
#asm
            pop hl
            ld c, (hl)
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld b, #E0
            add hl, bc
            ld e, (hl)
            pop hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), 0
#endasm
End Function

' At(px, py): the tile under pixel px, py (0-319, 0-255), 0 off the map
Public Function At(ByVal px As Integer, ByVal py As Integer) As Integer
#asm
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld d, (hl)              ; px
            pop hl
            ld c, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld b, (hl)              ; py
            ld a, b
            or a
            jr nz, at_off
            ld a, d
            cp 2
            jr nc, at_off
            ld hl, -320
            add hl, de
            jr c, at_off
            srl d                   ; px / 8
            rr e
            srl e
            srl e
            ld a, c
            and #F8                 ; (py / 8) * 8
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            ld b, h
            ld c, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, bc              ; (py / 8) * 40
            ld d, #E0
            add hl, de
            ld e, (hl)
            jr at_set
at_off:
            ld e, 0
at_set:
            pop hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), 0
#endasm
End Function

' Fill t: every cell tile t
Public Sub Fill(ByVal t As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld hl, #E000
            ld de, #E001
            ld bc, 40 * 32 - 1
            ld (hl), a
            ldir
#endasm
End Sub

' Rect x, y, w, h, t: a block of cells
Public Sub Rect(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal w As Integer, ByVal h As Integer, ByVal t As Integer)
  Dim i As Integer, j As Integer
  For j = y To y + h - 1
    For i = x To x + w - 1
      Put i, j, t
    Next
  Next
End Sub

' Text x, y, s: text from cell x, y (the font tiles), no wrap, no scroll
Public Sub Text(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal s As String)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld c, (hl)
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld b, #E0
            add hl, bc
            ex de, hl
            pop hl
tx_lp:
            ld a, (hl)
            or a
            jr z, tx_done
            ld (de), a
            inc hl
            inc de
            ld a, d
            cp #E5                  ; past the map's end (#E500)
            jr nc, tx_done
            jr tx_lp
tx_done:
#endasm
End Sub

' Scroll x, y: the tilemap moved by x (0-319) and y (0-255) pixels
Public Sub Scroll(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer)
  Nx.Reg &H2F, (x \ 256) And 3
  Nx.Reg &H30, x And 255
  Nx.Reg &H31, y And 255
End Sub

files.name: Sfx.cls
files.text:
' Sfx - sound effects on the Next's AY chip (the first of its three), straight on the ports:
' #FFFD picks a register, #BFFD writes it. Three channels, each playing one effect at a time:
' a tone or noise whose pitch slides and whose volume fades to nothing over its length.
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
' Call Update once a frame (50 a second).
'   Sfx.Play 0, 200, 8, 15, 12, 0     ' channel A: tone period 200, rising pitch... 12 frames
Option Explicit

Private per(2) As Integer         ' the tone period now (12 bits; noise: 0-31)
Private slide(2) As Integer       ' added to it each frame
Private vol(2) As Integer         ' the volume it starts at (0-15)
Private total(2) As Integer       ' its length in frames
Private left(2) As Integer        ' frames to go (0 = silent)
Private nse(2) As Integer         ' 1 = noise, 0 = tone
Private mix As Integer

Private Sub W(ByVal r As Integer, ByVal v As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld bc, #FFFD
            out (c), a
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld b, #BF
            out (c), a
#endasm
End Sub

' Init: AY 1 picked (the Next has three: Turbosound), every channel quiet
Public Sub Init()
  Dim i As Integer
  Out &HFFFD, &HFF                 ' AY 1 (Turbosound: #FF, #FE, #FD pick the chips)
  For i = 0 To 13
    W i, 0
  Next
  W 7, &H3F
  For i = 0 To 2
    left(i) = 0
  Next
End Sub

' Play ch, period, slidePerFrame, volume, frames, noise: start an effect on channel ch (0-2)
Public Sub Play(ByVal ch As Integer, ByVal period As Integer, ByVal sl As Integer, ByVal volume As Integer, ByVal frames As Integer, ByVal noise As Integer)
  If ch < 0 Or ch > 2 Then Exit Sub
  per(ch) = period : slide(ch) = sl : vol(ch) = volume : total(ch) = frames : left(ch) = frames : nse(ch) = noise
End Sub

' Busy(ch): True while channel ch plays
Public Function Busy(ByVal ch As Integer) As Integer
  Busy = (left(ch) > 0)
End Function

' Update: once a frame - the pitches slide, the volumes fade, the AY written
Public Sub Update()
  Dim i As Integer, v As Integer, p As Integer
  mix = &H3F
  For i = 0 To 2
    If left(i) > 0 Then
      v = (vol(i) * left(i) + total(i) - 1) \ total(i)
      p = per(i)
      If nse(i) Then
        W 6, p And 31
        mix = mix And Not (8 * (2 ^ i))
      Else
        W i * 2, p And 255
        W i * 2 + 1, (p \ 256) And 15
        mix = mix And Not (2 ^ i)
      End If
      W 8 + i, v
      per(i) = per(i) + slide(i)
      If per(i) < 1 Then per(i) = 1
      left(i) = left(i) - 1
    Else
      W 8 + i, 0
    End If
  Next
  W 7, mix
End Sub

' Quiet: every channel stopped
Public Sub Quiet()
  Dim i As Integer
  For i = 0 To 2
    left(i) = 0
    W 8 + i, 0
  Next
End Sub

files.name: Road.cls
files.text:
' Road - the road and the sky for ESCORT, on Layer 2, bent and rolled by the copper.
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
'
' Layer 2 holds a picture that never changes: the sky in rows 0-79 (Scenery.cls), and below it
' 112 straight roads, one a row, each a little wider than the one above (row 80 + dy: half a
' width of dy x 5 / 8 pixels, kerbs, a line down the middle). On screen, the line dy below the
' horizon shows row 80 + dy - so the vertical scroll is the same all the way down - and the copper
' sets, for each line:
'   the horizontal scroll (NextReg #16): where the road is on that line - the bends (shifting the
'     far lines most) and where you are across it (shifting the near lines most)
'   the palette offset (NextReg #70): light or dark stripes (grass, kerbs, road, the dashes) by
'     how far away the line is, so they rush towards you as you drive.
' Build makes the copper's list for the next frame; Show (straight after Frame) loads it.
' Distances: the line dy below the horizon is 888 / dy metres away (14208 / dy sixteenths); across,
' 1 unit is 6 / 128 of a metre, and x units are x * dy / 128 pixels on that line (the road's
' half width, 3.75 metres, is 80; the kerbs go out to about 92).
Option Explicit

Public Const SKYROWS = 80, ROWS = 112

Private inv(127) As Byte          ' 255 / dy
Private zl(127) As Integer        ' the line's distance: 14208 / dy (16ths of a metre)
Private lim(127) As Byte          ' how far the line may move before the road wraps round
Private sh(127) As Byte           ' how far each line moved this frame (signed)
Private cop(1023) As Byte         ' the copper's list
Private oat(109) As Byte          ' the roadside things' sprites (22 x 5 attribute bytes: slots 4-25)
Private copLen As Integer, cp As Integer, sps As Integer, yy As Integer, hor As Integer
Private ofl As Integer, ofull As Integer, opat As Integer, ox As Integer, od As Integer, odst As Integer
Private cam As Integer, l16 As Integer, l70 As Integer
Private crv As Integer, camx As Integer, zpos As Integer, skyx As Integer, s16 As Integer

' Init: Layer 2 on; its palette's road colours; the road rows drawn; the sky drawn; the tables
Public Sub Init()
  Dim dy As Integer, hw As Integer, rw As Integer
  Nx.Reg &H70, 0
  Nx.Reg &H12, 16
  Nx.Reg &H1C, 1
  Nx.Reg &H18, 0 : Nx.Reg &H18, 255 : Nx.Reg &H18, 0 : Nx.Reg &H18, 191
  Nx.Reg &H16, 0 : Nx.Reg &H17, 0
  ' the road's colours: 1-4 the light stripes, 17-20 the dark (palette offset 1)
  Nx.Reg &H43, &H10
  Colour 1, &H34 : Colour 2, &HE4 : Colour 3, &H92 : Colour 4, &HFF
  Colour 17, &H30 : Colour 18, &HFF : Colour 19, &H6E : Colour 20, &H6E
  Nx.Reg &H43, 0
  Template
  Scenery.Draw
  Out &H123B, 2
  For dy = 0 To 127
    If dy = 0 Then inv(0) = 255 Else inv(dy) = 255 \ dy
    If dy = 0 Then zl(0) = 14208 Else zl(dy) = 14208 \ dy
    hw = dy : If hw > ROWS - 1 Then hw = ROWS - 1
    rw = hw \ 10 + 1
    hw = hw \ 2 + hw \ 8
    lim(dy) = 124 - hw - rw
    sh(dy) = 0
  Next
End Sub

Private Sub Colour(ByVal i As Integer, ByVal v As Integer)
  Nx.Reg &H40, i
  Nx.Reg &H41, v
End Sub

' the 112 road rows (80-191): grass, kerbs, road, the middle line
Private Sub Template()
#asm
            ld ({sps}), sp
            ld sp, (ntc_csp)
            xor a
            ld ({yy}), a
tp_row:
            ld a, ({yy})            ; the row: 80 + dy
            add a, 80
            ld c, a
            rlca                    ; its page: 32 + row / 32, into slot 6
            rlca
            rlca
            and 7
            add a, 32
            ld e, a
            push bc
            ld bc, #243B
            ld a, #56
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), e
            pop bc
            ld a, c
            and 31
            add a, #C0
            ld h, a                 ; HL = the row's start
            ld l, 0
            ld ({cp}), hl
            ld (hl), 1              ; grass all along
            ld d, h
            ld e, 1
            ld bc, 255
            ldir
            ld a, ({yy})            ; hw = dy * 5 / 8; rw = dy / 10 + 1; mw = dy / 28
            srl a
            ld b, a
            srl a
            srl a
            add a, b
            ld ({hor}), a           ; (hw, for now)
            ld a, ({yy})
            ld e, 26
            ld d, a
tp_zm1:
            db #ED, #30             ; mul d, e: dy * 26 / 256 = dy / 10
            ld a, d
            inc a
            ld ({crv}), a           ; (rw)
            ld a, ({yy})
            ld e, 9
            ld d, a
tp_zm2:
            db #ED, #30             ; dy * 9 / 256 = dy / 28
            ld a, d
            ld ({camx}), a          ; (mw)
            ; the kerbs: 128 - hw - rw .. 128 + hw + rw
            ld a, ({hor})
            ld b, a
            ld a, ({crv})
            add a, b
            ld b, a                 ; hw + rw
            ld a, 128
            sub b
            ld e, a
            ld a, b
            add a, a
            ld b, a
            ld c, 2
            call tp_span
            ; the road: 128 - hw .. 128 + hw
            ld a, ({hor})
            or a
            jr z, tp_next
            ld b, a
            ld a, 128
            sub b
            ld e, a
            ld a, b
            add a, a
            ld b, a
            ld c, 3
            call tp_span
            ; the line down the middle: 128 - mw .. 128 + mw
            ld a, ({camx})
            or a
            jr z, tp_next
            ld b, a
            ld a, 128
            sub b
            ld e, a
            ld a, b
            add a, a
            ld b, a
            ld c, 4
            call tp_span
tp_next:
            ld a, ({yy})
            inc a
            ld ({yy}), a
            cp 112
            jp nz, tp_row
            ld bc, #243B            ; slot 6 back to bank 5
            ld a, #56
            out (c), a
            inc b
            ld a, 10
            out (c), a
            jp tp_done
; B bytes of colour C from x = E of the row at ({cp})
tp_span:
            ld hl, ({cp})
            ld l, e
tp_sp:
            ld (hl), c
            inc hl
            djnz tp_sp
            ret
tp_done:
            ld sp, ({sps})
#endasm
End Sub

' Build h, curve, cx, z, sx: the copper list for the next frame - the horizon at paper line h
' (72-100), the bend (-127 .. 127: how far the horizon end moves, pixels; + bends right), where you
' are across the road (cx, -127 .. 127: the camera's place, 1 unit = 6/128 m, + right), how far
' you have come (z, 16ths of a metre - only its stripes matter, so it may wrap), the sky's scroll
Public Sub Build(ByVal h As Integer, ByVal curve As Integer, ByVal cx As Integer, ByVal z As Integer, ByVal sx As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld ({hor}), a
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld ({crv}), a
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld ({camx}), a
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld d, (hl)
            ld ({zpos}), de
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld ({skyx}), a
            ld ({sps}), sp
            ld sp, (ntc_csp)
            ld hl, {cop}
            ld ({cp}), hl
            ; the sky: its scroll; the rows from the top (the same vertical scroll all the way down)
            ld b, #16
            ld a, ({skyx})
            call bu_emit
            ld b, #17
            ld a, ({hor})
            ld c, a
            ld a, 80
            sub c
            jr nc, bu_v
            add a, 192
bu_v:
            call bu_emit
            ld b, #70
            xor a
            call bu_emit
            ; the lines below the horizon: only what changes from the line above is sent
            ld a, ({hor})
            inc a
            ld ({yy}), a
            xor a
            ld ({s16}), a           ; dy (from 1)
            ld hl, 0
            ld ({cam}), hl          ; camx * dy, added up line by line
            ld a, ({skyx})
            ld ({l16}), a           ; the last horizontal scroll sent
            xor a
            ld ({l70}), a           ; the last palette offset sent
bu_lp:
            ld a, ({s16})           ; dy + 1
            inc a
            ld ({s16}), a
            ld e, a
            ld d, 0
            ; the bend: crv * inv(dy) / 256, rounded towards 0
            ld hl, {inv}
            add hl, de
            ld e, (hl)
            ld a, ({crv})
            call bu_smul            ; HL = crv * inv (signed)
            ld c, h                 ; C = the bend (signed)
            ; where you are: (camx * dy) / 128, added up
            ld a, ({camx})
            ld e, a
            rla
            sbc a, a
            ld d, a
            ld hl, ({cam})
            add hl, de
            ld ({cam}), hl
            add hl, hl              ; / 128
            ld e, h
            ld a, h
            rla
            sbc a, a
            ld d, a                 ; DE = the camera's shift
            ld a, c
            ld l, a
            rla
            sbc a, a
            ld h, a
            or a
            sbc hl, de              ; HL = bend - where you are
            ; kept within lim(dy) both ways
            ld a, ({s16})
            ld e, a
            ld d, 0
            ex de, hl
            ld bc, {lim}
            add hl, bc
            ld c, (hl)
            ex de, hl
            bit 7, h
            jr nz, bu_neg
            ld a, h
            or a
            jr nz, bu_hi
            ld a, l
            cp c
            jr c, bu_ok
bu_hi:
            ld l, c
            jr bu_ok
bu_neg:
            ld a, h
            inc a
            jr nz, bu_lo
            ld a, l
            neg
            cp c
            jr c, bu_ok
            jr z, bu_ok
bu_lo:
            ld a, c
            neg
            ld l, a
bu_ok:
            ld a, ({s16})
            ld e, a
            ld d, 0
            ld a, l
            ld hl, {sh}             ; sh(dy) = it
            add hl, de
            ld (hl), a
            neg
            ld b, a                 ; B = the scroll for this line
            ; the stripes: bit 6 of (the line's distance + how far you have come)
            ld hl, {zl}
            add hl, de
            add hl, de
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld de, ({zpos})
            add hl, de
            ld a, l
            rlca
            rlca
            and 1
            ld c, a                 ; C = the palette offset
            ; anything to send?
            ld a, ({s16})
            cp 112
            jr nc, bu_send          ; below the last road row: always (the vertical scroll)
            ld a, ({l16})
            cp b
            jr nz, bu_send
            ld a, ({l70})
            cp c
            jr z, bu_next
bu_send:
            ld hl, ({cp})
            ld a, ({yy})            ; WAIT for the end of the line before (h 40)
            dec a
            ld (hl), #D0
            inc hl
            ld (hl), a
            inc hl
            ld a, ({l16})
            cp b
            jr z, bu_n16
            ld (hl), #16
            inc hl
            ld (hl), b
            inc hl
            ld a, b
            ld ({l16}), a
bu_n16:
            ld a, ({l70})
            cp c
            jr z, bu_n70
            ld (hl), #70
            inc hl
            ld (hl), c
            inc hl
            ld a, c
            ld ({l70}), a
bu_n70:
            ld a, ({s16})
            cp 112
            jr c, bu_n17
            ld (hl), #17
            inc hl
            ld a, ({yy})
            ld c, a
            ld a, 191
            sub c
            ld (hl), a
            inc hl
bu_n17:
            ld ({cp}), hl
bu_next:
            ld a, ({yy})
            inc a
            ld ({yy}), a
            cp 192
            jp nz, bu_lp
            ld hl, ({cp})           ; the end: HALT
            ld (hl), #FF
            inc hl
            ld (hl), #FF
            inc hl
            ld de, {cop}
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            ld ({copLen}), hl
            jp bu_done
; a MOVE: register B, value A
bu_emit:
            ld hl, ({cp})
            ld (hl), b
            inc hl
            ld (hl), a
            inc hl
            ld ({cp}), hl
            ret
; HL = A (signed) * E (0-255), signed
bu_smul:
            ld d, a
            bit 7, a
            jr z, bu_sp
            neg
            ld d, a
bu_zm1:
            db #ED, #30             ; mul d, e
            ex de, hl
            xor a
            sub l
            ld l, a
            sbc a, a
            sub h
            ld h, a
            ret
bu_sp:
bu_zm2:
            db #ED, #30
            ex de, hl
            ret
bu_done:
            ld sp, ({sps})
#endasm
End Sub

' Show: the list to the copper (straight after Frame, in the top border): the copper stopped, the
' list written from the start, then started again (restarting each frame)
Public Sub Show()
#asm
            ld bc, #243B
            ld a, #61
            out (c), a
            inc b
            xor a
            out (c), a
            dec b
            ld a, #62
            out (c), a
            inc b
            xor a
            out (c), a              ; stopped, index 0
            dec b
            ld a, #60
            out (c), a
            inc b
            ld hl, {cop}
            ld de, ({copLen})
            srl d                   ; words
            rr e
sw_lp:
            ld a, (hl)
            out (c), a
            inc hl
            ld a, (hl)
            out (c), a
            inc hl
            dec de
            ld a, d
            or e
            jr nz, sw_lp
            dec b
            ld a, #62
            out (c), a
            inc b
            ld a, #C0
            out (c), a              ; start: from 0, again at each frame
#endasm
End Sub

' Shift(dy): how far the line dy below the horizon moved this frame (pixels, + right)
Public Function Shift(ByVal dy As Integer) As Integer
  Dim v As Integer
  If dy > 127 Then dy = 127
  v = sh(dy)
  If v > 127 Then v = v - 256
  Shift = v
End Function

' Obj j, d, x, pat, fl, full: roadside thing j's sprite (slot 4 + j) for something d sixteenths of a
' metre from the eye (72 - 11500, else hidden), x across (units of 6/128 m), its first pattern,
' attribute 2 (palette x 16, mirrors; + 1: one drawing only, no sizes), and how many units its
' full-size drawing stands for: the size picked from 8, 12, 16, 24, 32, 48, 64 pixels (the
' drawings at 1/2, 3/4 and full size, shown 1x, 2x or 4x), standing on the road at its distance
Public Sub Obj(ByVal j As Integer, ByVal d As Integer, ByVal x As Integer, ByVal pat As Integer, ByVal fl As Integer, ByVal full As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld l, a                 ; the record: oat + j * 5
            ld h, 0
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld de, {oat}
            add hl, de
            ld ({odst}), hl
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld d, (hl)
            ld ({od}), de
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld d, (hl)
            ld ({ox}), de
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld ({opat}), a
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld ({ofl}), a
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld ({ofull}), a
            ; near enough, far enough?
            ld hl, ({od})
            bit 7, h
            jp nz, ob_hide
            ld de, 72
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            jp c, ob_hide
            ld hl, ({od})
            ld de, 11500
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            jp nc, ob_hide
            ; dy = 14208 / d (AC / DE)
            ld de, ({od})
            ld a, #37               ; 14208 = #3780
            ld c, #80
            ld hl, 0
            ld b, 16
ob_dv:
            sla c
            rla
            adc hl, hl
            sbc hl, de
            jr c, ob_dr
            inc c
            djnz ob_dv
            jr ob_dd
ob_dr:
            add hl, de
            djnz ob_dv
ob_dd:
            or a
            jp nz, ob_hide          ; (over 255)
            ld a, c
            cp 151
            jp nc, ob_hide
            ld ({yy}), a            ; yy = dy
            ; its size: full * dy / 128
            ld d, a
            ld a, ({ofull})
            ld e, a
ob_zm1:
            db #ED, #30             ; mul d, e
            ex de, hl
            add hl, hl
            ld a, h                 ; A = full * dy / 128 (up to 255)
            cp 5
            jp c, ob_hide
            ld bc, #0001            ; B: the drawing (0, 1, 2), C: the scale (1, 2, 4)
            cp 10
            jr c, ob_sz
            ld b, 1
            cp 14
            jr c, ob_sz
            ld b, 2
            cp 20
            jr c, ob_sz
            ld bc, #0102
            cp 28
            jr c, ob_sz
            ld bc, #0202
            cp 40
            jr c, ob_sz
            ld bc, #0104
            cp 56
            jr c, ob_sz
            ld bc, #0204
ob_sz:
            ld a, ({ofl})
            and 1
            jr z, ob_sizes
            ld b, 0                 ; one drawing only
ob_sizes:
            ld a, ({opat})
            add a, b
            ld ({opat}), a
            ld a, c
            ld ({ofull}), a         ; (the scale, from here on)
            ; x: 128 + shift(dy) + (x / 2) * dy / 64 - 8 * scale + 32
            ld hl, ({ox})
            sra h
            rr l                    ; x / 2: -128 .. 127
            ld a, l
            ld b, 0
            bit 7, a
            jr z, ob_xp
            neg
            ld b, 1
ob_xp:
            ld d, a
            ld a, ({yy})
            ld e, a
ob_zm2:
            db #ED, #30             ; |x / 2| * dy
            ex de, hl
            add hl, hl              ; / 64: * 4, / 256
            add hl, hl
            ld l, h
            ld h, 0
            ld a, b
            or a
            jr z, ob_xs
            xor a
            sub l
            ld l, a
            sbc a, a
            sub h
            ld h, a
ob_xs:
            ex de, hl               ; DE = the offset
            ld a, ({yy})
            cp 128
            jr c, ob_sh
            ld a, 127
ob_sh:
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            ld bc, {sh}
            add hl, bc
            ld a, (hl)              ; shift(dy), signed
            ld l, a
            rla
            sbc a, a
            ld h, a
            add hl, de
            ld de, 160              ; + 128 + 32
            add hl, de
            ld a, ({ofull})         ; - 8 * scale
            add a, a
            add a, a
            add a, a
            ld e, a
            ld d, 0
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            ld a, h                 ; 0 .. 300, or hidden
            or a
            jr z, ob_xok
            dec a
            jp nz, ob_hide
            ld a, l
            cp 45
            jp nc, ob_hide
ob_xok:
            ld ({ox}), hl           ; (the sprite's x)
            ; y: hor + dy - 16 * scale + 33
            ld a, ({hor})
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            ld a, ({yy})
            ld e, a
            ld d, 0
            add hl, de
            ld de, 33
            add hl, de
            ld a, ({ofull})
            add a, a
            add a, a
            add a, a
            add a, a
            ld e, a
            ld d, 0
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            ld a, h
            or a
            jp nz, ob_hide
            ld a, l
            cp 224
            jp nc, ob_hide
            ; the attributes
            ld c, l                 ; C = y
            ld hl, ({odst})
            ld a, ({ox})
            ld (hl), a              ; 0: x
            inc hl
            ld (hl), c              ; 1: y
            inc hl
            ld a, ({ox} + 1)
            and 1
            ld b, a
            ld a, ({ofl})
            and #FE
            or b
            ld (hl), a              ; 2: palette, mirrors, x bit 8
            inc hl
            ld a, ({opat})
            ld c, a
            srl a
            or #C0
            ld (hl), a              ; 3: shown, 5 bytes, pattern / 2
            inc hl
            ld a, c
            and 1
            rrca
            rrca
            or #80                  ; 4: 4 bit, pattern bit 0, the scale
            ld b, a
            ld a, ({ofull})
            cp 2
            jr nz, ob_s4
            ld a, b
            or #0A
            jr ob_s
ob_s4:
            cp 4
            ld a, b
            jr nz, ob_s
            or #14
ob_s:
            ld (hl), a
            jp ob_done
ob_hide:
            ld hl, ({odst})
            inc hl
            inc hl
            inc hl
            ld (hl), #40            ; not shown
ob_done:
#endasm
End Sub
